definitions.gloss: demolition; teardown; pulling down a building
definitions.explanation: The act of deliberately destroying a building or structure in order to remove it. Commonly refers to planned demolition of old buildings to make way for new construction.

examples.japanese: {古|ふる}いビルの{取|と}り{壊|こわ}しが{始|はじ}まった。
examples.english: The demolition of the old building has begun.

examples.japanese: この{家|いえ}は{来月|らいげつ}{取|と}り{壊|こわ}しになる{予定|よてい}だ。
examples.english: This house is scheduled for demolition next month.

examples.japanese: {歴史的|れきしてき}な{建物|たてもの}の{取|と}り{壊|こわ}しに{反対|はんたい}する{住民|じゅうみん}が{署名|しょめい}を{集|あつ}めている。
examples.english: Residents opposing the demolition of the historic building are collecting signatures.

notes:
The noun form of the compound verb {取|と}り{壊|こわ}す (to tear down/demolish). Composed of {取|と}り (taking) + {壊|こわ}し (breaking). Commonly used in real estate, urban planning, and construction contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {取|と}り{壊|こわ}し{工事|こうじ}: demolition work
- {取|と}り{壊|こわ}しが{決|き}まる: demolition is decided
- {取|と}り{壊|こわ}しになる: to be slated for demolition
- {取|と}り{壊|こわ}し{費用|ひよう}: demolition costs
- {建物|たてもの}の{取|と}り{壊|こわ}し: demolition of a building

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {解体|かいたい}: dismantling — more technical/formal, also used for organizations
- {撤去|てっきょ}: removal — removing structures, signs, or obstacles
- {破壊|はかい}: destruction — violent or unplanned destruction, not just buildings
